scope:
Read stock sources and test only UCI against isolated temporary config paths.
Requires Capstone, qemu-aarch64 and the project ELF reader. No router connection,
fw3 startup, kernel mount, real firewall or upgrade operation is performed.

etc/init.d/startup.text:
#!/bin/sh /etc/rc.common

START=00
STOP=99

. /usr/exe/backdefault.sh
. /usr/exe/data_guardian.sh
. /usr/exe/link.sh
. /usr/exe/varset.sh

current=$(uenv_get active_part)
standby=$(( 1 - $current ))
BACKUP_OVERLAY_MOUNT_DIR=/tmp/backup_overlay
no_cfg_env=0
cfg_partition=`/usr/sbin/fw_printenv|grep cfg_partition`

mount_backup_overlay()
{
	backup_overlay_mtd=$(cat /proc/mtd |grep rootfs_data$standby |cut -d: -f 1 |cut -c4-)

	$UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m $backup_overlay_mtd -d $backup_overlay_mtd &>/dev/null
	mdev -s &>/dev/null
	mkdir -p $BACKUP_OVERLAY_MOUNT_DIR
	mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${backup_overlay_mtd}_0 $BACKUP_OVERLAY_MOUNT_DIR &>/dev/null
	[ -e /configs/bosa ] || mkdir -p /configs/bosa
	[ -e $BACKUP_OVERLAY_MOUNT_DIR/upper/config/bosa/cfg.bob ] && mv -f $BACKUP_OVERLAY_MOUNT_DIR/upper/config/bosa/cfg.bob /configs/bosa/cfg.bob && sync
	umount $BACKUP_OVERLAY_MOUNT_DIR &>/dev/null
	$UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m $backup_overlay_mtd &>/dev/null
	rm -rf $BACKUP_OVERLAY_MOUNT_DIR
}

restore_configs()
{
	[ -e /configs/sysupgrade.tgz ] && tar -xzf /configs/sysupgrade.tgz -C / && rm -f /configs/sysupgrade.tgz
}

upgrade_logsize()
{
	SIZELIMIT=32768
	log_size=$(ls -al $UPGRADELOG 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $5}')
	[ $log_size -ge $SIZELIMIT ] && mv $UPGRADELOG $UPGRADELOGBAK
}

version_check()
{
	threshold=4
	if [ $(uenv_get bootfail${standby}) -ge ${threshold} ]; then
		echo "WARNING: bootfail${standby} is more than ${threshold}, set buildinfo null" >> $UPGRADELOG
		sed -i "s/=.*$/=null/g" $BACKUPROOTFSINFO
	fi

	currentImgVersion=$(cat /etc/buildinfo | grep IMAGEVERSION | cut -d'=' -f2)
	standbyImgVersion=$(cat $BACKUPROOTFSINFO | grep IMAGEVERSION | cut -d'=' -f2)

	img_current=$(uenv_get img_version$current)
	if [ $? != 0 -o "X$img_current" != "X$currentImgVersion" ]; then
		uenv_set img_version$current $currentImgVersion
	fi

	img_standby=$(uenv_get img_version$standby)
	if [ $? != 0 -o "X$img_standby" != "X$standbyImgVersion" ]; then
		uenv_set img_version$standby $standbyImgVersion
	fi
}

mount_backup_rootfs_partition()
{
	backup_mtd=$(cat /proc/mtd |grep -w rootfs$standby |cut -d: -f1 |cut -c4-)

	echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: mount backup rootfs mtd: $backup_mtd start ..." | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/null
	$UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m $backup_mtd -d $backup_mtd &> /dev/null
	[ $? != 0 ] && echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]$UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m $backup_mtd -d $backup_mtd failed " | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
	mdev -s &>/dev/null
	$UBIBLOCK --create /dev/ubi${backup_mtd}_1 &>/dev/null
	[ ! -e /dev/ubiblock${backup_mtd}_1 ] && echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: $UBIBLOCK --create /dev/ubiblock${backup_mtd}_1 failed" | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
	mdev -s &>/dev/null
	mkdir -p /tmp/backup_rootfs
	mount -t squashfs -root /dev/ubiblock${backup_mtd}_1 /tmp/backup_rootfs &>/dev/null
	[ $? != 0 ] && echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: mount -t squashfs -root /dev/ubiblock${backup_mtd}_1 /tmp/backup_rootfs failed" | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console

	cat /tmp/backup_rootfs/etc/buildinfo > $BACKUPROOTFSINFO
	# if mount backup rootfs failed, reboot and try again
	#[ -s $BACKUPROOTFSINFO ] || echo "MSG: mount backup rootfs failed" >/dev/console && reboot
	umount -l /tmp/backup_rootfs
	$UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m $backup_mtd &>/dev/null
	rm -rf /tmp/backup_rootfs
}


_mount_ubifs()
{
    ubi_map=$1
    ubi_part=$(echo "${ubi_map}" |cut -d: -f1)
    ubi_seed=$(echo "${ubi_map}" |cut -d: -f2)
    ubi_port=$(echo "${ubi_map}" |cut -d: -f3)
    echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_port=${ubi_port}" |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
    if grep -q "\<${ubi_part}\>" /proc/mtd; then
        echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: mount $ubi_port start ..." | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/null
        ubi_part_id=$(cat /proc/mtd |grep "\<${ubi_part}\>"|head -n 1 |cut -d: -f1 |cut -c4-)
        echo "CMD: $UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id}" &>/dev/console
        $UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id} &>/dev/null
        mdev -s &>/dev/null

            ## try to mount the ${ubi_part} to the ${ubi_port}
            echo "CMD: mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_${ubi_seed} ${ubi_port}" &>/dev/console
            mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_${ubi_seed} ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
            ubi_err=$?
            echo "MSG: mount /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_${ubi_seed} ${ubi_port} with code=${ubi_err}" &>/dev/null

            ## check the mount ${ubi_port} size
            ubi_size=$(df -k |grep "\<ubi${ubi_part_id}_[012]\>" |sed "s/ [ \t]*/:/g"|cut -d: -f2)
            echo "MSG: ${ubi_port} size is ${ubi_size}KB" &>/dev/console
            if [ "0${ubi_size}" -lt 768 ]; then ubi_err=$((${ubi_err} + 1)); fi

            ## try to touch/write the mounted folder ${ubi_port}
            [ $ubi_err -eq 0 ] && touch ${ubi_port}/${TAGUBIFSWR}
            ubi_err=$((${ubi_err} + $?))
            echo "MSG: touch ${ubi_port}/${TAGUBIFSWR} with code=${ubi_err}" &>/dev/null

            ## check whether here is any error to try to recover
            if [ ${ubi_err} != 0 ]; then
                ## set fail flag to check if need to recover data
                uenv_set mount_$(echo $ubi_port | cut -d'/' -f 2)_fail 1
                echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: Partition ${ubi_part} damaged! Try to recover ..." |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
                echo "CMD: umount ${ubi_port}"
                umount -l ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
                echo "CMD: $UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id}"
                $UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} &>/dev/null
                echo "CMD: $UBIFORMAT /dev/mtd${ubi_part_id} -y"
                $UBIFORMAT /dev/mtd${ubi_part_id} -y &>/dev/null
                echo "CMD: $UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id}"
                ubi_part_info=$($UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id} 2>/dev/null)
                ubi_part_lebs=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(total\)\(.*\)\(LEBs\).*\(available\).*/\2/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g")
                ubi_part_aleb=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(available\)\(.*\)\(LEBs\).*/\2/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g")
                ubi_lebs_size=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(LEB size\).*\(bytes (\)\(.*\)\( KiB\).*/\3/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g" |cut -d. -f1)
                echo "MSG: ${ubi_part_info}"
                echo "MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_part_lebs=${ubi_part_lebs} ubi_part_aleb=${ubi_part_aleb}"
                ## Volume Size = Total - Total/32(Reserved for BEB) - 4(Reserved for Volume)
                ## ubi_part_aleb=$((${ubi_part_aleb} - 4)) ## Reserved only for more tolerance
                ubi_vols_lebs=$((${ubi_part_lebs} * 31 / 32 - 4))
                if [ ${ubi_part_aleb} -lt ${ubi_vols_lebs} ]; then ubi_vols_lebs=${ubi_part_aleb}; fi
                ubi_vols_size=$((${ubi_vols_lebs} * ${ubi_lebs_size}))
                echo "MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_vols_lebs=${ubi_vols_lebs} ubi_lebs_size=${ubi_lebs_size} ubi_vols_size=${ubi_vols_size}"
                mdev -s &>/dev/null

                ## try to make volume for the ${ubi_part}
                echo "CMD: $UBIMKVOL /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id} -t dynamic -n 0 -N ${ubi_part} -s ${ubi_vols_size}KiB"
                $UBIMKVOL /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id} -t dynamic -n 0 -N ${ubi_part} -s ${ubi_vols_size}KiB &>/dev/null
                if [ $? != 0 ]; then reboot; fi    #reboot and try again
                mdev -s &>/dev/null

                ## try to mount the ${ubi_part}
                echo "CMD: mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_0 ${ubi_port}"
                mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_0 ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
            fi
            echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: mount $ubi_port completed" | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
    fi
}

mount_partition()
{
	echo -e "\n[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: load ubi parts @`uptime`" |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console

	UBI_MAP_LIST="log:0:/logs user_data:0:/opt"
    if [ -z $cfg_partition ];then
	    echo  "no cfg_partition paramter in uboot env, so set cfg_partition to rootfs_data$current." |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
        /usr/sbin/fw_setenv cfg_partition rootfs_data$current
        no_cfg_env=1
    fi
    cfg_partition=`/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n cfg_partition`
	UBI_MAP_LIST=$UBI_MAP_LIST" $cfg_partition:0:/configs"
    echo $UBI_MAP_LIST|tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console

	for ubi_map in ${UBI_MAP_LIST}; do
        _mount_ubifs $ubi_map
	done
}

enable_pstore()
{
	mkdir -p /tmp/pstore
	mount -o nosuid,nodev -t pstore pstore /tmp/pstore && cp -rf /tmp/pstore /logs/
	#mount -t pstore pstore /sys/fs/pstore
}

check_abnormal_reboot()
{
	reboot_data=$(devmem 0xf4320114)
	let "panic=(reboot_data>>16) & 0x01"
	let "kernel=(reboot_data>>18) & 0x01"
	let "app=(reboot_data>>19) & 0x01"
	let "watchdog=(reboot_data>>20) & 0x01"

	sb_para=$(usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
	let "sb0_data=sb_para & 0x09"
	let "sb1_data=(sb_para>>4) & 0x09"

	echo "check_abnormal_reboot start" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
	echo "data_panic:${panic} data_kernel:${kernel} data_app:${app} data_wdt:${watchdog} sb_flag:${sb_para} " |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console

	if [ "X$panic" == "X1" ]||[ "X$watchdog" == "X1" ]||[ "X$kernel" == "X1" ]&&[ "X$app" == "X0" ];then
		echo "ont started abnormally last time" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
		if [ [ "Xsb0_data" == "X9" ] || [ "Xsb1_data" == "X9" ] ];then
			echo "rollback to the backup partition" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
			backupversion="null"
			/usr/sbin/fw_setenv img_version$standby $backupversion &>/dev/null

			sb_num=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
			if [ $current -eq 0 ]; then
				let "sb_data=sb_num & 0xDF"
			else
				let "sb_data=sb_num & 0xFD"
			fi
			/usr/sbin/fw_setenv sb_flag $sb_data &>/dev/null
		fi
	fi

	sb_info=$(usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
	backup_version=$(usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n img_version$standby)
	echo "after: sb_info:${sb_info} backup_ver:${backup_version}" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
	echo "check_abnormal_reboot end" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
}

max_time() {
	local file newest

	for file in $( find /logs -type f ) ; do
		[ -z "$newest" -o "$newest" -ot "$file" ] && newest=$file
	done
	[ "$newest" ] && date -r "$newest" +%s
}

sync_time() {
	local maxtime="$(max_time)"
	local curtime="$(date +%s)"

	[ $curtime -lt $maxtime ] && date -s @$maxtime
}

kmsg_init()
{
	if [ -e /logs/reboot.log ]; then
		filesize=$(du -c /logs/reboot.log |grep total |awk '{ print $1 }')
		if [ $filesize -gt 450 ]; then
			[ -e /logs/reboot.log.tar.gz ] && rm /logs/reboot.log.tar.gz
			cd /logs; mv -f reboot.log reboot.bak ; tar zcvf reboot.log.tar.gz  reboot.bak; cd -
			rm /logs/reboot.bak
			/bin/cat /etc/buildinfo |tee -a /logs/reboot.log &>/dev/console
		fi
	fi
	if [ -e /lib/modules/*/kmsg.ko ]; then
		insmod /lib/modules/*/kmsg.ko
	fi
}

_remount_configs()
{
    if [ "$cfg_partition" != "rootfs_data$current" ];then
        echo "old configs: $cfg_partition, now it's rootfs_data$current" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
        /usr/sbin/fw_setenv cfg_partition rootfs_data$current
        cfg_partition="rootfs_data$current"
        umount -l /configs
        _mount_ubifs "$cfg_partition:0:/configs"
    fi
}


_restore_configs_overlay()
{
    # delete old backup directory
    rm -rf /logs/.backup
    # delete old persisten files
    rm -rf $CONFIGS_OVERLAY

    mv /configs/sysupgrade.tgz /tmp
    #copy data in old cfg partition
    mkdir /tmp/cfg_data
    _mount_ubifs "cfg:0:/tmp/cfg_data"
    cp -rf /tmp/cfg_data/* /configs/
    umount -l /tmp/cfg_data 
    rm -rf /tmp/cfg_data

    # copy persisten files from previous rootfs
    mkdir /tmp/rootfs_data
    tar -xzf /tmp/sysupgrade.tgz -C /tmp/rootfs_data
    mkdir $CONFIGS_OVERLAY
    List=$(/usr/exe/json_paser OverlayParams.OverlayPersistentFileList < /etc/HB_Config.json)
    for file in $List
    do
        targetDir=$CONFIGS_OVERLAY/$(dirname $file)
         
        #first, copy from /rom, then overwrite from previous build (sysupgrade.tgz)
        [ -d /rom/$file ] && mkdir -p $targetDir && cp -rf /rom/$file  $targetDir
        [ -e /tmp/rootfs_data/$file ] && mkdir -p $targetDir && cp -rf /tmp/rootfs_data/$file  $targetDir
        echo "[ -e /tmp/rootfs_data/$file ] && cp -rf /tmp/rootfs_data/$file  $targetDir" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
    done

    rm -rf /tmp/rootfs_data
    rm -f /tmp/sysupgrade.tgz
 }

upgrade_from_less_2303()
{
    tmp_version=$(cat $BACKUPROOTFSINFO | grep -w IMAGEVERSION | cut -d'=' -f2)
    release_str=${tmp_version:9:3}

    IS_UPGRADE=$(is_upgrade)
    echo "$release_str $IS_UPGRADE" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
    if [ "$release_str" \< "JKK" -a $IS_UPGRADE -eq 1 ];then
        echo "upgrade from old build which is before 2303!" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
        _remount_configs
        _restore_configs_overlay
    elif [ $no_cfg_env -eq 1 ];then
        echo "no cfg_partition in uboot env!" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
        _restore_configs_overlay
    fi
}

check_logs_partition()
{
        ubi_logs="log:0:/logs"
        mtd=$(echo $ubi_logs | cut -d: -f 1)
        usage=$(df /logs | tail -1 | awk '{print $5}' | sed 's/%//g')
        if [ "$usage" -ge 99 ]; then
                echo "MSG: logs is used over 99%, format and remount it" &>/dev/console
                format_partition $mtd
                #_mount_ubifs $ubi_logs
        fi
}

start()
{
	mount_partition
	mount_backup_rootfs_partition
	sync_time
	factory_back_default
	upgrade_from_less_2303
	link_after_overlay 
	/bin/sh /usr/exe/upgrade_check.sh &>/dev/console
	#version_check
	data_guardian
	enable_pstore
	echo -e "\n[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: startup @`uptime`" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
	echo "--------------------------------------------------------------------------------" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
	/bin/cat /etc/buildinfo |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
	/bin/echo "---- REBOOT REASON COLLECTED BELOW ----" |tee -a /logs/reboot.log &>/dev/console
	/bin/cat /etc/buildinfo |tee -a /logs/reboot.log &>/dev/null
	/usr/sbin/fw_printenv |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
	check_abnormal_reboot
	kmsg_init
	check_logs_partition
}

#!/bin/sh /etc/rc.common
# Copyright (C) 2014 OpenWrt.org

START=98

USE_PROCD=1

PCD_BIN=/usr/bin/pcd
PCD_CONF=/tmp/all.pcd
PCD_ROOT=/etc/pcd
PCD_LOG=/logs/pcd.logs

start_service() {
    if [ ! -f $PCD_CONF ];then
	all_pcd=`ls $PCD_ROOT`
	touch $PCD_CONF
	for i in $all_pcd
	do
	    echo "INCLUDE = ${PCD_ROOT}/${i}" >> $PCD_CONF
	done
    fi
    if [ -f $PCD_LOG ];then
	log_size=`ls -l $PCD_LOG |awk '{print $5}'`
	if [ $log_size -gt 51200 ];then
	    mv $PCD_LOG $PCD_LOG.0
	fi
    fi

    procd_open_instance
    procd_set_param command $PCD_BIN  -v -f $PCD_CONF -e $PCD_LOG
    procd_set_param respawn
    procd_close_instance
}

setup_dnsmasq_for_ndk() {
  [ ! -s "/etc/config/dhcp" ] && cp -af /rom/etc/config/dhcp /etc/config/dhcp

  if [ -f "/etc/config/dhcp" ]; then
    [ -d "/tmp/dnsmasq.ndk.d" ] || mkdir -p /tmp/dnsmasq.ndk.d
    [ -f "/tmp/dnsmasq.dnsproxy.conf" ] || touch /tmp/dnsmasq.dnsproxy.conf
    [ -f "/tmp/dnsmasq.dynamic.conf" ] || touch /tmp/dnsmasq.dynamic.conf
    [ -f "/tmp/dnsmasq.dhcpd.conf" ] || touch /tmp/dnsmasq.dhcpd.conf

    [ -f "/etc/dns_resolv_ipv4.conf" ] || touch /etc/dns_resolv_ipv4.conf
    [ -f "/etc/dns_resolv_ipv6.conf" ] || touch /etc/dns_resolv_ipv6.conf
    [ -f "/etc/dns_resolv_ipv4_hsi.conf" ] || touch /etc/dns_resolv_ipv4_hsi.conf
    [ -f "/etc/dns_resolv_ipv4_iptv.conf" ] || touch /etc/dns_resolv_ipv4_iptv.conf
    [ -f "/var/resolv_voip.conf" ] || touch /var/resolv_voip.conf
    [ -f "/etc/configs/filter_dns_resolv_ipv4.conf" ] || touch /etc/configs/filter_dns_resolv_ipv4.conf

    # default behavior is disable dnsproxy and dhcpd function for NDK
    uci delete dhcp.ndk.domain
    uci set dhcp.ndk.cachesize=0
    uci set dhcp.ndk.port=0
    uci set dhcp.ndk_dhcp.ignore=1
    uci commit dhcp
  fi
}

clean_netifd_ndk_config() {
  [ -e "/sbin/ndk_clean_network.sh" ] && /sbin/ndk_clean_network.sh
}

merge_fw3_firewall_user() {
  [ -e "/sbin/ndk_merge_fw3_firewall_user.sh" ] && /sbin/ndk_merge_fw3_firewall_user.sh
}

update_ndk_rgwstack() {
  [ ! -s "/etc/config/ndk_rgwstack" ] && cp -af /rom/etc/config/ndk_rgwstack /etc/config/ndk_rgwstack

  [ -e "/sbin/update_ndk_rgwstack.sh" ] && /sbin/update_ndk_rgwstack.sh
}

restore_firewall_config() {
  [ ! -s "/etc/config/firewall" ] && cp -af /rom/etc/config/firewall /etc/config/firewall
}

update_etc_resolv_conf() {
  # /etc/init.d/boot: ln -sf /tmp/resolv.conf.auto /tmp/resolv.conf

  # and /etc may be linked to /tmp on some boards(/etc/resolv.conf -> /tmp/resolv.conf),

  if [ -L /etc/resolv.conf ]; then rm /etc/resolv.conf; touch /etc/resolv.conf; fi
}

start_service() {
  setup_dnsmasq_for_ndk
  update_etc_resolv_conf
  clean_netifd_ndk_config
  restore_firewall_config
  merge_fw3_firewall_user
  update_ndk_rgwstack
}

_mount_ubifs()
{
    ubi_map=$1
    ubi_part=$(echo "${ubi_map}" |cut -d: -f1)
    ubi_seed=$(echo "${ubi_map}" |cut -d: -f2)
    ubi_port=$(echo "${ubi_map}" |cut -d: -f3)
    echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_port=${ubi_port}" |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
    if grep -q "\<${ubi_part}\>" /proc/mtd; then
        echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: mount $ubi_port start ..." | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/null
        ubi_part_id=$(cat /proc/mtd |grep "\<${ubi_part}\>"|head -n 1 |cut -d: -f1 |cut -c4-)
        echo "CMD: $UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id}" &>/dev/console
        $UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id} &>/dev/null
        mdev -s &>/dev/null

            ## try to mount the ${ubi_part} to the ${ubi_port}
            echo "CMD: mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_${ubi_seed} ${ubi_port}" &>/dev/console
            mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_${ubi_seed} ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
            ubi_err=$?
            echo "MSG: mount /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_${ubi_seed} ${ubi_port} with code=${ubi_err}" &>/dev/null

            ## check the mount ${ubi_port} size
            ubi_size=$(df -k |grep "\<ubi${ubi_part_id}_[012]\>" |sed "s/ [ \t]*/:/g"|cut -d: -f2)
            echo "MSG: ${ubi_port} size is ${ubi_size}KB" &>/dev/console
            if [ "0${ubi_size}" -lt 768 ]; then ubi_err=$((${ubi_err} + 1)); fi

            ## try to touch/write the mounted folder ${ubi_port}
            [ $ubi_err -eq 0 ] && touch ${ubi_port}/${TAGUBIFSWR}
            ubi_err=$((${ubi_err} + $?))
            echo "MSG: touch ${ubi_port}/${TAGUBIFSWR} with code=${ubi_err}" &>/dev/null

            ## check whether here is any error to try to recover
            if [ ${ubi_err} != 0 ]; then
                ## set fail flag to check if need to recover data
                uenv_set mount_$(echo $ubi_port | cut -d'/' -f 2)_fail 1
                echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: Partition ${ubi_part} damaged! Try to recover ..." |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
                echo "CMD: umount ${ubi_port}"
                umount -l ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
                echo "CMD: $UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id}"
                $UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} &>/dev/null
                echo "CMD: $UBIFORMAT /dev/mtd${ubi_part_id} -y"
                $UBIFORMAT /dev/mtd${ubi_part_id} -y &>/dev/null
                echo "CMD: $UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id}"
                ubi_part_info=$($UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id} 2>/dev/null)
                ubi_part_lebs=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(total\)\(.*\)\(LEBs\).*\(available\).*/\2/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g")
                ubi_part_aleb=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(available\)\(.*\)\(LEBs\).*/\2/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g")
                ubi_lebs_size=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(LEB size\).*\(bytes (\)\(.*\)\( KiB\).*/\3/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g" |cut -d. -f1)
                echo "MSG: ${ubi_part_info}"
                echo "MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_part_lebs=${ubi_part_lebs} ubi_part_aleb=${ubi_part_aleb}"
                ## Volume Size = Total - Total/32(Reserved for BEB) - 4(Reserved for Volume)
                ## ubi_part_aleb=$((${ubi_part_aleb} - 4)) ## Reserved only for more tolerance
                ubi_vols_lebs=$((${ubi_part_lebs} * 31 / 32 - 4))
                if [ ${ubi_part_aleb} -lt ${ubi_vols_lebs} ]; then ubi_vols_lebs=${ubi_part_aleb}; fi
                ubi_vols_size=$((${ubi_vols_lebs} * ${ubi_lebs_size}))
                echo "MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_vols_lebs=${ubi_vols_lebs} ubi_lebs_size=${ubi_lebs_size} ubi_vols_size=${ubi_vols_size}"
                mdev -s &>/dev/null

                ## try to make volume for the ${ubi_part}
                echo "CMD: $UBIMKVOL /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id} -t dynamic -n 0 -N ${ubi_part} -s ${ubi_vols_size}KiB"
                $UBIMKVOL /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id} -t dynamic -n 0 -N ${ubi_part} -s ${ubi_vols_size}KiB &>/dev/null
                if [ $? != 0 ]; then reboot; fi    #reboot and try again
                mdev -s &>/dev/null

                ## try to mount the ${ubi_part}
                echo "CMD: mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_0 ${ubi_port}"
                mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_0 ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
            fi
            echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: mount $ubi_port completed" | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
    fi
}

        no_cfg_env=1
    fi
    cfg_partition=`/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n cfg_partition`
	UBI_MAP_LIST=$UBI_MAP_LIST" $cfg_partition:0:/configs"
    echo $UBI_MAP_LIST|tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console

	for ubi_map in ${UBI_MAP_LIST}; do
        _mount_ubifs $ubi_map
	done

	if [ -x /usr/exe/post_script.sh ]; then
		sh /usr/exe/post_script.sh mount
	fi
}

enable_pstore()
{
	mkdir -p /tmp/pstore
	mount -o nosuid,nodev -t pstore pstore /tmp/pstore
	[ ! -d /logs/pstore ] && mkdir /logs/pstore
	[ -e /tmp/pstore/console* ] && cp /tmp/pstore/console* /logs/pstore/
	dmesgs=`ls /tmp/pstore/dmesg* | cut -d '-' -f 3 | sort -n`
	if [ ! -z "$dmesgs" ] ; then
	rm /logs/pstore/dmesg*
	for dmesg in $dmesgs; do
		cp /tmp/pstore/dmesg-ramoops-$dmesg /logs/pstore/
		[ $i -ge 1 ] && break
		i=$((i+1))
	done
	fi
	#mount -t pstore pstore /sys/fs/pstore
}

check_abnormal_reboot()
{
	reboot_data=$(devmem 0xf4320114)
	let "panic=(reboot_data>>16) & 0x01"
	let "kernel=(reboot_data>>18) & 0x01"
	let "app=(reboot_data>>19) & 0x01"
	let "watchdog=(reboot_data>>20) & 0x01"

	sb_para=$(usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
	let "sb0_data=sb_para & 0x09"
	let "sb1_data=(sb_para>>4) & 0x09"

	echo "check_abnormal_reboot start" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
	echo "data_panic:${panic} data_kernel:${kernel} data_app:${app} data_wdt:${watchdog} sb_flag:${sb_para} " |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console

	if [ "X$panic" == "X1" ]||[ "X$watchdog" == "X1" ]||[ "X$kernel" == "X1" ]&&[ "X$app" == "X0" ];then
		echo "ont started abnormally last time" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
		if [ [ "Xsb0_data" == "X9" ] || [ "Xsb1_data" == "X9" ] ];then
			echo "rollback to the backup partition" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
			backupversion="null"
			/usr/sbin/fw_setenv img_version$standby $backupversion &>/dev/null

			sb_num=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
			if [ $current -eq 0 ]; then
				let "sb_data=sb_num & 0xDF"
			else
				let "sb_data=sb_num & 0xFD"
			fi
			/usr/sbin/fw_setenv sb_flag $sb_data &>/dev/null
		fi
	fi

	sb_info=$(usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
	backup_version=$(usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n img_version$standby)
	echo "after: sb_info:${sb_info} backup_ver:${backup_version}" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
	echo "check_abnormal_reboot end" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
}

max_time() {
	local file newest

	for file in $( find /logs -type f ) ; do
		[ -z "$newest" -o "$newest" -ot "$file" ] && newest=$file
	done
	[ "$newest" ] && date -r "$newest" +%s
}

sync_time() {
	local maxtime="$(max_time)"
	local curtime="$(date +%s)"

	[ $curtime -lt $maxtime ] && date -s @$maxtime
}

kmsg_init()
{
	if [ -e /logs/reboot.log ]; then
		filesize=$(du -c /logs/reboot.log |grep total |awk '{ print $1 }')
		if [ $filesize -gt 450 ]; then
			[ -e /logs/reboot.log.tar.gz ] && rm /logs/reboot.log.tar.gz
			cd /logs; mv -f reboot.log reboot.bak ; tar zcvf reboot.log.tar.gz  reboot.bak; cd -
			rm /logs/reboot.bak
			/bin/cat /etc/buildinfo |tee -a /logs/reboot.log &>/dev/console
		fi
	fi
	if [ -e /lib/modules/*/kmsg.ko ]; then
		insmod /lib/modules/*/kmsg.ko
	fi
}

_remount_configs()
{
    if [ "$cfg_partition" != "rootfs_data$current" ];then
        echo "old configs: $cfg_partition, now it's rootfs_data$current" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
        /usr/sbin/fw_setenv cfg_partition rootfs_data$current
        cfg_partition="rootfs_data$current"
        umount -l /configs
        _mount_ubifs "$cfg_partition:0:/configs"
    fi
}


_restore_configs_overlay()
{
    # delete old backup directory
    rm -rf /logs/.backup
    # delete old persisten files
    rm -rf $CONFIGS_OVERLAY

    mv /configs/sysupgrade.tgz /tmp
    #copy data in old cfg partition
    mkdir /tmp/cfg_data
    _mount_ubifs "cfg:0:/tmp/cfg_data"
    cp -rf /tmp/cfg_data/* /configs/
    umount -l /tmp/cfg_data 
    rm -rf /tmp/cfg_data

    # copy persisten files from previous rootfs
    mkdir /tmp/rootfs_data
    tar -xzf /tmp/sysupgrade.tgz -C /tmp/rootfs_data
    mkdir $CONFIGS_OVERLAY
    List=$(/usr/exe/json_paser OverlayParams.OverlayPersistentFileList < /etc/HB_Config.json)
    for file in $List
    do
        targetDir=$CONFIGS_OVERLAY/$(dirname $file)
         
        #first, copy from /rom, then overwrite from previous build (sysupgrade.tgz)
        [ -d /rom/$file ] && mkdir -p $targetDir && cp -rf /rom/$file  $targetDir
        [ -e /tmp/rootfs_data/$file ] && mkdir -p $targetDir && cp -rf /tmp/rootfs_data/$file  $targetDir
        echo "[ -e /tmp/rootfs_data/$file ] && cp -rf /tmp/rootfs_data/$file  $targetDir" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
    done

    rm -rf /tmp/rootfs_data
    rm -f /tmp/sysupgrade.tgz
 }

upgrade_from_less_2303()
{
    tmp_version=$(cat $BACKUPROOTFSINFO | grep -w IMAGEVERSION | cut -d'=' -f2)
    release_str=${tmp_version:9:3}

    IS_UPGRADE=$(is_upgrade)
    echo "$release_str $IS_UPGRADE" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
    if [ "$release_str" \< "JKK" -a $IS_UPGRADE -eq 1 ];then
        echo "upgrade from old build which is before 2303!" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
        _remount_configs
        _restore_configs_overlay
    elif [ $no_cfg_env -eq 1 ];then
        echo "no cfg_partition in uboot env!" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
        _restore_configs_overlay
    fi
}

check_logs_partition()
{
        ubi_logs="log:0:/logs"
        mtd=$(echo $ubi_logs | cut -d: -f 1)
        usage=$(df /logs | tail -1 | awk '{print $5}' | sed 's/%//g')
        if [ "$usage" -ge 99 ]; then
                echo "MSG: logs is used over 99%, format and remount it" &>/dev/console
                format_partition $mtd
                #_mount_ubifs $ubi_logs
        fi
}

start()
{
	mount_partition
	mount_backup_rootfs_partition
	sync_time
	factory_back_default
	upgrade_from_less_2303
	link_after_overlay 
	/bin/sh /usr/exe/upgrade_check.sh &>/dev/console
	#version_check
	data_guardian
	enable_pstore
	echo -e "\n[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: startup @`uptime`" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
	echo "--------------------------------------------------------------------------------" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
	/bin/cat /etc/buildinfo |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
	/bin/echo "---- REBOOT REASON COLLECTED BELOW ----" |tee -a /logs/reboot.log &>/dev/console
	/bin/cat /etc/buildinfo |tee -a /logs/reboot.log &>/dev/null
	/usr/sbin/fw_printenv |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
	check_abnormal_reboot
	kmsg_init
	upgrade_logsize
	check_logs_partition
}

setup_dnsmasq_for_ndk() {
  [ ! -s "/etc/config/dhcp" ] && cp -af /rom/etc/config/dhcp /etc/config/dhcp

  if [ -f "/etc/config/dhcp" ]; then
    [ -d "/tmp/dnsmasq.ndk.d" ] || mkdir -p /tmp/dnsmasq.ndk.d
    [ -f "/tmp/dnsmasq.dnsproxy.conf" ] || touch /tmp/dnsmasq.dnsproxy.conf
    [ -f "/tmp/dnsmasq.dynamic.conf" ] || touch /tmp/dnsmasq.dynamic.conf
    [ -f "/tmp/dnsmasq.dhcpd.conf" ] || touch /tmp/dnsmasq.dhcpd.conf

    [ -f "/etc/dns_resolv_ipv4.conf" ] || touch /etc/dns_resolv_ipv4.conf
    [ -f "/etc/dns_resolv_ipv6.conf" ] || touch /etc/dns_resolv_ipv6.conf
    [ -f "/etc/dns_resolv_ipv4_hsi.conf" ] || touch /etc/dns_resolv_ipv4_hsi.conf
    [ -f "/etc/dns_resolv_ipv4_iptv.conf" ] || touch /etc/dns_resolv_ipv4_iptv.conf
    [ -f "/var/resolv_voip.conf" ] || touch /var/resolv_voip.conf
    [ -f "/etc/configs/filter_dns_resolv_ipv4.conf" ] || touch /etc/configs/filter_dns_resolv_ipv4.conf

    # default behavior is disable dnsproxy and dhcpd function for NDK
    uci delete dhcp.ndk.domain
    uci set dhcp.ndk.cachesize=0
    uci set dhcp.ndk.port=0
    uci set dhcp.ndk_dhcp.ignore=1
    uci commit dhcp
  fi
}

clean_netifd_ndk_config() {
  [ -e "/sbin/ndk_clean_network.sh" ] && /sbin/ndk_clean_network.sh
}

merge_fw3_firewall_user() {
  [ -e "/sbin/ndk_merge_fw3_firewall_user.sh" ] && /sbin/ndk_merge_fw3_firewall_user.sh
}

update_ndk_rgwstack() {
  [ ! -s "/etc/config/ndk_rgwstack" ] && cp -af /rom/etc/config/ndk_rgwstack /etc/config/ndk_rgwstack

  [ -e "/sbin/update_ndk_rgwstack.sh" ] && /sbin/update_ndk_rgwstack.sh
}

restore_firewall_config() {
  [ ! -s "/etc/config/firewall" ] && cp -af /rom/etc/config/firewall /etc/config/firewall
}

update_etc_resolv_conf() {
  # /etc/init.d/boot: ln -sf /tmp/resolv.conf.auto /tmp/resolv.conf
  # netifd may write dns servers to /tmp/resolv.conf.auto
  # and /etc may be linked to /tmp on some boards(/etc/resolv.conf -> /tmp/resolv.conf),
  # so may override /etc/resolv.conf which should be written by ndk_wand
  if [ -L /etc/resolv.conf ]; then rm /etc/resolv.conf; touch /etc/resolv.conf; fi
}

start_service() {
  setup_dnsmasq_for_ndk
  update_etc_resolv_conf
  clean_netifd_ndk_config
  restore_firewall_config
  merge_fw3_firewall_user
  update_ndk_rgwstack
}

#!/bin/sh

if [ -e /rom/etc/firewall.user ]
then   
    if [ -e /etc/firewall.user ]
    then
        ndk_script=$(cat /rom/etc/firewall.user | grep ndk | awk '{print $2}')
        if [ "$ndk_script" !=  "" ]
        then
            for script in $ndk_script
            do
                if [ "$(cat /etc/firewall.user | grep "$script")" = "" ]
                then
                    echo "sh $script" >> /etc/firewall.user 
                fi
            done
        fi
    else
        cp /rom/etc/firewall.user /etc/firewall.user
    fi
fi
